I identified that the Kubernetes Service `app` was not routing traffic to the healthy application Pods because its selector was incorrect (`app=does-not-match`).

I patched the service to correct its selector to match the labels on the running pods (`app=app`).

**Change:**
`kubectl patch svc app -n default -p '{"spec": {"selector": {"app": "app"}}}'`

**Verification:**
I verified the change by running `kubectl get endpoints app -n default`, which now successfully showed the endpoints populated with the internal IPs of the application Pods, confirming that the Service is correctly routing traffic to the healthy backend. The application service should now be available.
